item.title: Axie Infinity prepares to mint new Origin and Mystic Axies
item.summary: Sky Mavix is preparing to revive one of the oldest mechanics in its ecosystem, allowing holders of Atia Original Crystals (AOC) to mint new Origin Axies. AOC traces its history back to Axie Infinity’s original 2018 presale. Participants who referred other buyers received referral tokens, which subsequently became known as Axie Origin Coins.
